title: Found Myself In a Tunnel Between Rooms/Shops In Mallworld The Other Night
content: Can't remember were I came from, or where I was going. But found myself in a tight dark tunnel that was connecting different rooms in mallworld. It was very tight to crawl through with all sorts of metal gears, sprockets, and lots of oil/grease dripping about. It seemed super dangerous but there was enough room too squeeze through. It was maybe around 200 feet long. Visually it seemed maybe similar to the underground workings in Dark City, or the engine room in Snowpiercer...
